invariants.name: no hardcoded game values
invariants.diagnosis: A game value was inlined instead of read from the version registry. Judge by whether a specific entity, item or enchantment is named — a bare 'minecraft:' namespace prefix being constructed by a serializer is fine.

invariants.name: no version-number comparisons
invariants.diagnosis: Serializers branch on version traits, never on version numbers. This is the failure the 1.21.2 attribute rename triggers.

invariants.name: no literal hex
invariants.diagnosis: An inlined colour silently opts that element out of runtime theming, and the breakage only shows in a theme nobody was looking at. The fix is to add a token upstream, never to inline or approximate.

invariants.name: no literal px
invariants.diagnosis: The scale deliberately names the awkward steps (9px, 0.5px, 10px radius) precisely because those are the ones that get inlined.

generated.diagnosis: A non-empty diff means src/data/generated was hand-edited, or a generator change was committed without its output. If offline, report this as skipped rather than failed — it fetches mcmeta.
A non-empty diff means src/styles/tokens.css was hand-edited, or tokens.source.json was refreshed without regenerating. The generator reads a committed local file, so this one works offline.
